title: ‘The biggest risk to cybersecurity is that no one cares’
gist: Kemba Walden, former US National Cyber Director, says the biggest cybersecurity risk is apathy and urges reframing cyber as an opportunity, with businesses rather than individuals doing the heavy lifting.

insights.claim: Cybersecurity's supreme enemy is apathy because people see it as abstract and do not link it to banking, energy access and societal stability.
insights.speaker: World Economic Forum
insights.quote: The biggest risk to cybersecurity is that no one cares

insights.claim: Walden argues cybersecurity should be reframed as an opportunity and that businesses, not individuals, must carry the heavy lifting.
insights.speaker: World Economic Forum
insights.so_what: Corporate responsibility and cyber investment shift.
